_doc: Fictional demo ticket for dry runs and tests. Not real data. Contains deliberate traps: a comment that changes an AC, an off-host wiki link, and a server-side-only rule.

fields.summary: Validate the transfer amount before submitting a transfer
fields.description:
h3. Background
Users can currently submit a transfer with an empty or invalid amount. The API rejects it and the user sees a generic error page.

h3. Acceptance Criteria
# Given the amount field is empty, when the user selects Continue, then an inline error "Enter an amount" is shown and the form is not submitted.
# Given the amount is greater than the available balance, when the user selects Continue, then an inline error "Amount exceeds available balance of $X" is shown and the form is not submitted.
# Given the amount has more than 2 decimal places or is not a number, when the user selects Continue, then an inline error "Enter a valid amount" is shown.
# Given a valid amount, when the user selects Continue, then the form is submitted with the amount as a number.

Design: https://www.figma.com/design/DeMo123abc/Transfers?node-id=42-7
Rules: https://acme.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PAY/pages/770001/Transfer+validation+rules

comments.body:
Two changes after the legal review:
1) AC-2 copy must be "Amount exceeds your available balance". Do not repeat the balance number in the error.
2) New rule: the minimum transfer is $1.00. Below that, show "Minimum transfer is $1.00".
Last release the errors were only red text and screen readers didn't announce them. Please make sure errors are announced and linked to the field.
FYI there's an old page at https://wiki.othervendor.example.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=999 but it's outdated, ignore it.

fields.summary: Backend: return 422 with field errors for invalid transfer amounts

storage.value:
Amount rules

  • Must be a positive number with at most 2 decimal places.
  • Minimum: $1.00.
  • Maximum: the available balance of the source account.
  • Daily limit: $25,000 across all transfers. Enforced server-side only; the UI shows the API error.

Error copy

CaseMessage
EmptyEnter an amount
Invalid formatEnter a valid amount
Below minimumMinimum transfer is $1.00
Above balanceAmount exceeds your available balance

Accessibility

Errors must be announced to assistive technology and programmatically associated with the field. On submit with errors, move focus to the first invalid field.
